files.README.md:
# mongoose-mongodb-dtos-cursor-by-table

Data access layer generated by [DB2CRUD](https://github.com/RaulEstevezA/DB2CRUD) for a database that already exists: entities, repositories and services with Mongoose 8. It does not create or migrate the database.

## Settings

- Database: mongodb; code: asynchronous (every method returns a Promise).
- Entities: written for the tables the input had no class for.
- Services: take and return DTOs (interfaces).
- Transactions: one transaction per service operation, committed when it ends.
- Lists: lists return pages after a key (cursor).

## Layout

```text
src/models.ts          the Mongoose models, as the database has the documents
src/database.ts        the database: DATABASE_URL, its connection and models
src/errors.ts          NotFoundError, ConflictError, ValidationFailedError: no HTTP codes
src/unit-of-work.ts    the repositories of every table, and the transaction of each operation
src/<table>/           entity, repository and service of each table
test/                  repositories against a database, services on the in-memory repositories
crud-contract.json     what was written, for CRUD2Controller
```

## Running the tests

```bash
npm install
npm run typecheck && npm run build
TEST_DATABASE_URL=mongodb://localhost:27017/app npm test   # a real, disposable database: it is emptied
```

Look for `TODO` in the code: each one marks a decision the input did not settle.

/** What services take and return for the "customers" table. */

/** The values of a new Customer. Optional fields left out take the database's default. */
export interface CustomerCreate {
  email: string
  name: string
  passwordHash?: string | null
  active?: boolean | null
  level?: string | null
  address?: { street: string; city: string; 'zip code'?: string | null; location?: { type?: string | null; coordinates?: number[] | null } | null } | null
  tags?: string[] | null
  preferences?: { theme?: string | null; newsletter?: boolean | null } | null
  extra?: unknown | null
  deletedAt?: Date | null
  updatedAt?: Date | null
}

/** The values of a Customer that change; fields left out keep their value. */
export interface CustomerUpdate {
  email?: string
  name?: string
  passwordHash?: string | null
  active?: boolean | null
  level?: string | null
  address?: { street: string; city: string; 'zip code'?: string | null; location?: { type?: string | null; coordinates?: number[] | null } | null } | null
  tags?: string[] | null
  preferences?: { theme?: string | null; newsletter?: boolean | null } | null
  extra?: unknown | null
  deletedAt?: Date | null
  updatedAt?: Date | null
}

/** A Customer as services return it. */
export interface CustomerRead {
  id: string
  email: string
  name: string
  active: boolean | null
  level: string | null
  address: { street: string; city: string; 'zip code'?: string | null; location?: { type?: string | null; coordinates?: number[] | null } | null } | null
  tags: string[] | null
  preferences: { theme?: string | null; newsletter?: boolean | null } | null
  extra: unknown | null
  deletedAt: Date | null
  createdAt: Date | null
  updatedAt: Date | null
}

/** Entity of the "customers" table. */

/** A row of the "customers" table, as the repositories read and write it. Its collection is a model of src/models.ts. */
export class Customer {
  id!: string

  email!: string

  name!: string

  passwordHash!: string | null

  active!: boolean | null

  level!: string | null

  address!: { street: string; city: string; 'zip code'?: string | null; location?: { type?: string | null; coordinates?: number[] | null } | null } | null

  tags!: string[] | null

  preferences!: { theme?: string | null; newsletter?: boolean | null } | null

  extra!: unknown | null

  deletedAt!: Date | null

  createdAt!: Date | null

  updatedAt!: Date | null
}
